correctness.rationale: The 12 value/first-derivative intensities lift to a real-linear 12x16 map on Hermitian 4x4 matrices. Independently reconstructed this map over Q(sqrt(3)), verified rank 11 and all five independent generators H(a,b,t,y). Any phase-inequivalent equal-intensity pair gives a nonzero traceless rank-two Hermitian difference with inertia (1,1). Independently derived all four principal 3x3 minor identities and the determinant, including the a=0,b=0 square-completion forcing y=±2|t|/3 and Im(t^3)=∓|t|^3; a=0,b!=0 branch; a!=0 F0/F3 factor -(3/4)(4a+9b)(4a²+21ab+24b²), the t=0 branch and the unique viable kappa=(-21-sqrt(57))/48 branch. Independent exact SymPy arithmetic verified all fourteen listed matrices are traceless nonzero rank-two and verified 91 pairwise projector differences by expanding/cancelling a nonzero entry. The eigenvector partner formula preserves the cross terms and flips the two diagonal masses when |alpha|!=|beta|, yielding dense genuine ambiguities on each range; outside the finite union, no such pair can occur. The pair 1±i z³ is explicitly inequivalent and has equal values and derivative magnitudes at every sixth root. Finite exact arithmetic checks verify the elimination identities; the analytic branch cases, not a sample search or log, give exhaustiveness. Scope is n=4 complex coefficients, sixth roots, both value and complex first derivative magnitudes, modulo unimodular phase, no numerical stability claim.

This motivates future stability and exception-aware reconstruction analyses without claiming such downstream theorems; the exact finite-dimensional classification is itself a mathematically useful complete answer.
